scope: WSL BoardSimulator only; no physical hardware; no official test dataset
tap_order: PyTorch Conv2d input-channel-major, kernel-row-major, kernel-column-major (3x5x5); first 32 then 75
data: CIFAR100 selected train-file classes 0,1,2,3,5,8,13,14,17,19; original 4500/500 stratified split seed 20261006, canonical index digest f3a5acaf7d61d1221b28a6ba66e468f905a44463630a8bdc5cf38cbb956f0492; no augmentation and no test
arrays: Fresh independent 32x8 BoardSimulator arrays per programming replicate and tile; only columns 0 and 1 programmed, G+ and G-
mapping: Gplus=0.03+0.02*w/maxabs75; Gminus=0.03-0.02*w/maxabs75; positive target mvm weights sum_gain/R; x>=0 spikes; DAC input 0.3*x V; restore dot as (MVMplus-MVMminus)*maxabs75/(0.04*0.3)
preflight: Verify checkpoint and source hashes, canonical split, maxabs75>0, target conductance 0.01..0.05, simulator connector type BoardSimulator, 32x8 orientation, analytic zero-error mapping, DAC max <=0.3V; otherwise abort
safety: Before EVERY mode_mvm, quantize all nonnegative inference inputs without clipping; reject requested or decoded voltage >0.3V, reject nonfinite/nonpositive measured AND actual simulated device resistance; calculate positive current as sum(decoded_voltage/resistance) for selected column, require strict current <0.015A; abort on ADC saturation; log current and margin each call. Programming pulses up to 3V separately logged; never classify those as inference inputs.
stage32: First benchmark one cell; abort if >20s per write or extrapolated 64 cells >900s; max 64 writes/replicate, total stage <=2700s; abort infeasible target readback if sign agreement <0.9 on abs(w)>0.05*maxabs, median normalized cell error >0.35; zero-noise simulator MVM must agree with programmed-readback digital to <=0.05*maxabs75 times number of nonzero inputs; val MVM vs ideal Pearson r>=0.8 and normalized RMSE <=0.6; must pass to extend 75 taps
stage75: Only after stage32 gate; <=150 writes/replicate across 3 tiles; no full Conv1; evaluate same split/patches
surrogate: Fit affine y_ideal=a+b*y_mvm using train patch outputs only; apply fixed coefficients to val; report val RMSE and Pearson r; no Paper1 training-update sigma substitution.
verdict: VALIDATED only if 3 full reprogramming replicates pass stage75 safety/mapping and val gates; PARTIAL if safe smaller stage passes or resource gate blocks further work; INVALIDATED if reproducible mapping/safety fails. Stop at any concrete blocker.
